nodes.title: 03 | EDIT PROMPT — identify target if several women
widgets_values:
Replace the woman in the driver's seat in <Video 1> with the woman from <Picture 1>.

Use the reference woman's facial identity, hair, freckles and visible upper-body proportions. Replace the original driver's appearance; do not retain her facial identity.

Keep the clothing from the source video. Follow the source woman's movements and performance. Preserve the car interior, camera, lighting and the passenger's hand.

Do not copy the reference photo's clothing or background. Omit creator-added captions and subtitles while retaining text physically present in the scene.

nodes.title: 02 | SOURCE REEL — upload video; first 73 frames
05 | SEED — fixed; keep for final pass
H3 AUDIO VAE — source conditioning only
AUTO | ceil to H3 frame grid
FINAL | separate video and audio latents
READ FIRST — original sampling, original models
widgets_values:
# AUTHOR SETTINGS — original LBH workflow3 sampling restored
Load the same photo (01), reel (02) and short prompt (03). Source inputs are already selected from your saved graph. Default trim remains 73 frames / about 3 seconds at 24 fps.
The original Euler sampler, FL2V LightX2V Turbo 4-step v0.1 (strength 1), sigma shift 12/3, raw-base simple scheduler with 8 steps split at 4, high_sigmas first pass and manual refine sigmas 0.9035, 0.6316, 0.3158, 0 are restored. Comfy kitchen attention and the original KJ live preview are also restored. Original Ref2VA INT8 and original latent-upscaler model names are restored. The original LoRA's local Windows subfolder has been removed from its filename only.
Added for your task: connected persona/source video/prompt, Character Swap 1.0, vertical format, original audio exports, automatic frame-grid padding and exact loaded-frame-count output trimming. Preview is the author's 0.2 MP; final is 1 MP.
Run preview first. Select FINAL OUTPUT (08), Ctrl+M, Run to enable final processing after a good preview. Leave seed and inputs unchanged. Cache reuse is session-dependent.
IMPORTANT: This file requires the ORIGINAL model files; do not substitute the previous Ref2V 8-step Turbo. Links for the original base, Turbo and latent upscaler are in AUTHOR_MODELS.md. Current LBH node widget serialization is used with the original checkpoint. KJNodes and taeh3 live-preview dependency are retained from the original.
No GPU render performed. Structural equality of the generation preset was checked against the downloaded original JSON. This is not a claim that the author's complete runtime or output can be reproduced exactly.
